messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — quickstart snippet in onboarding/runtime/quickstart.mdx uses `@redwood/runtime-client` but the package name changed.
Samir Patel: yup I hit an npm ERR yesterday when following that page.
Jonah Lee: @Maria Chen can you paste the file path so I can make a tiny fix?
Maria Chen: /handbook/onboarding/runtime/quickstart.mdx line ~12
DocsBot: docs-lint: error onboarding/runtime/quickstart.mdx:12 invalid-package-name `@redwood/runtime-client`
Kevin O'Neill: I can review a PR, but let's keep the hosted example parity. We changed the package but also updated auth pattern.
Samir Patel: proposed edit: replace `@redwood/runtime-client` -> `@redwood/inference-runtime` and update init to `const client = new InferenceClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })`
Tara Nguyen: @Kevin O'Neill I'll add a short note to changelog if you approve the snippet change.
Maria Chen: creating a tiny PR now, will add tests to docs harness to prevent regressions.
Jonah Lee: thanks — ping me when CI runs
Kevin O'Neill: :thumbsup: also add frontmatter flag `samplesChanged: true` so the sample diff shows in release notes
Maria Chen: PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pull/3421 — title "small: update quickstart import + init"
Samir Patel: merged to staging, quick smoke looks good.
Maria Chen: updated frontmatter owner: `owner: "Maria Chen"` on the file
Tara Nguyen: follow-up: can we create a redirect from old shortlink `/quickstart-runtime` to the new doc? users still click legacy links.
Maria Chen: filed TICKET-789 in docs backlog for redirect
DocsBot: deploy: staging/docs succeeded at 2026-03-19T15:04:12Z
Maria Chen: Closing — thanks all for quick help :heart:
